variables.detailed: Current Transaction ID when this transaction began, or (txnid_t)-1. Multiple readers that start at the same time will probably have the same ID here. Again, it's not important to exclude them from anything; all we need to know is which version of the DB they started from so we can avoid overwriting any data used in that particular version.

variables.detailed: Mutex protecting access to this table. This is the reader table lock used with LOCK_MUTEX().

variables.detailed: The ID of the last transaction committed to the database. This is recorded here only for convenience; the value can always be determined by reading the main database meta pages.

variables.detailed: The ID of this transaction. IDs are integers incrementing from 1. Only committed write transactions increment the ID. If a transaction aborts, the ID may be re-used by the next writer.

variables.detailed: The list of pages that became unused during this transaction.

variables.detailed: The sorted list of dirty pages we temporarily wrote to disk because the dirty list was full. page numbers in here are shifted left by 1, deleted slots have the LSB set.

variables.name: dirty_list
